title: Pro-etale localization preserves injectives
statement:
For a weakly etale $v:W\to X$, the site $W_{\Proet}$ is the slice of
$X_{\Proet}$ over $W$. The restriction functor on constant-coefficient module
sheaves is exact and preserves injectives. Consequently derived evaluation on
$W$, computed in sheaves on $X_{\Proet}$, agrees with derived global sections
on $W_{\Proet}$.

proof.text: Use the already proved concrete slice equivalence Scheme.ProEt.sliceEquiv and its sliceDense theorem from [lem-weil-proetale-weakly-etale-localization]. Its object, structure-arrow and morphism equalities are reflexivity; IsDenseSubsite.functorPushforward_mem_iff supplies precisely the required covering equivalence. Only this coefficient-independent part of the localization API is used, so no commutativity assumption is introduced.

proof.text: Set A = ModuleCat Lambda and let J be composition with W.hom. On A-valued sheaves restriction F is sheafPushforwardContinuous J. It preserves finite limits by the continuous-pushforward instance. The existing localizationRestrictionLowerStarAdjunction makes F a left adjoint, hence it preserves finite colimits. The explicit sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafPullback L is left adjoint to F by sheafAdjunctionContinuous. The source theorem SmallSite.preservesFiniteLimits_op_lan_overMap_of_isGrothendieckAbelian proves that J.op.lan is left exact for arbitrary weakly etale W.hom (not only monomorphisms); together with left exact sheafification and the sheaf inclusion this gives left exactness of L. This is the source-library implementation of the direct sum over lifts and sheafification in the blueprint. Specialize the existing ProEtale.preservesInjectiveObjects_localizationRestriction instance to A; equivalently apply [lem-sp-right-adjoint-preserves-injectives] to L adjoint to F. This works directly in ModuleCat for an arbitrary possibly noncommutative ring, without forgetting module injectivity.

proof.text: Restriction is additive sectionwise; its left adjoint L is additive by Adjunction.left_adjoint_additive. L preserves all colimits as a left adjoint and finite limits by the preceding step, hence preserves homology. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-right-adjoint-preserves-kinjective] to obtain F.PreservesKInjectiveComplexes. Existing Grothendieck and K-injective-resolution instances for ModuleCat-valued sheaves supply the hypotheses of the unbounded derived-functor API [lem-weil-pbc-kinjective-functorial-existence].

The factorization equations rightDerivedNatTrans_fac for the induced natural transformation and for rightDerivedUnique, after whiskering and associativity, give exactly the unit equation in the statement. Thus the witness is the canonical natural comparison on the full unbounded derived categories.
